instruction: Look at rotary_flute.step in NX CAM. Use NX CAM Simultaneous 5X or an indexed/rotary workflow for rotary_flute.step. Use the A axis as the rotary axis and machine four helical flutes. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm ball end mill for the rotary or simultaneous 5-axis flute toolpath. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-19.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
